# Affordi

> Affordi is a private calculator that converts a price into the work time needed to afford it.

People enter their take home pay, work schedule (including overnight shifts, unpaid breaks, and weekday-specific hours), and currency, then a price paid once, every workday, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Affordi shows the work time it takes, when it will have been earned working from now, and its share of take home pay or pay left after monthly costs. An earnings page counts what has been earned today in real time, both as a 24-hour equivalent and during working hours, shows how much of this month's pay has been worked for, and breaks pay down per second, minute, hour, day, week, month, and year. A monthly page adds up what is paid each month in work time and as a share of take home pay, with what is left each month and per day. It holds bills that change each month, such as electricity or water, entered month by month with a chart of the last twelve months and an accessible data table, and fixed costs paid monthly, quarterly, or yearly, such as rent, loans, insurance, or subscriptions, with how much of each loan is paid and how much is left to pay. Calculations, settings, fixed costs, and bills stay on the device with on-device JSON backup and import, offline PWA support, five bundled languages (English, German, French, Italian, and Serbian), and no account or tracking.

## Site

- [Affordi calculator](https://affordi.pages.dev/): Use the calculator in any supported language and install it as a progressive web app.
- [Affordi source and documentation](https://github.com/vladanp/affordi): Review the source code, README, development commands, and release history.
